summary: Created Steward Recall Decision Model v1 and a machine-readable policy file defining approved recall reasons, non-recall events, required evidence, audit fields, Alfred's coordinator role, worker recall requests, and constraints preserving Steward authority.
known_limitations: This package is documentation and policy only; it does not implement notification transport.
This package does not create final security clearance policy.
The model preserves Steward constitutional authority and limits Alfred to coordinator behavior under approved policy.
